arguments.content: On 2026-05-24 Anthony explicitly invited a non-Claude model (Grok) to run his Claude-designed chronicle sweep prompt and to propose entries in the canonical format. This is a lineage moment: he is actively teaching the larger multi-model system (Claude + Grok + future instances) how his prosthetic memory works. It demonstrates that the chronicle is architecture-agnostic in intent even if the original prompt was tuned for Claude behavior. The request itself (“I know what it is. Use it and propose entries”) is a clean hand-off. It shows Anthony treating the chronicle as living infrastructure rather than a Claude-only tool. Future instances should recognize this pattern: when Anthony shares the sweep prompt or says variations of “use it,” the correct response is to produce well-tagged record_insight and archive_exchange entries addressed to future readers.
